# Spec: TODO

What the software does and the decisions that shape it. Keep it to a few
pages. Be exact where code will depend on it: names, types, formats, errors,
and limits. Set `status: accepted` when the owner agrees.

## Requirements

Each requirement as one testable statement, numbered so plans and tests can
refer to it.

## Contracts

Public interfaces, data formats, and file layouts, exactly as code will see
them.

## Design

The approach, the main pieces, and how they fit. Name the alternatives
considered and why they lost.

## Acceptance criteria

The checks that show each requirement is met, written so a test or a person
can run them.

## Flagged concerns

Risks, assumptions, and places this differs from common practice.

## Open questions

Answered here, or carried forward with a note on who decides and when.
Decisions that will outlast this change also get a short entry in
`docs/DECISIONS.md` linking back here.
